subtitle: Most Stocks are Winning...but what about the Loser Stocks?!
title: Last Market Update This Week
description: Most Stocks are Winning...but what about the Loser Stocks?!
body_html:
Last update before I head out for a mini-vacation this week. I’ll be back next week. Still feel free to tag me in the Main Chat with any questions, and I will tag you back with a response…just give me a little time to respond.

If you are new here, my positions are updated daily at the StockTok Summary, along with the screened stocks; its scans 5000+ stocks daily and identifies high volume breakouts from consolidations. The StockTok ETF, was designed to be steadily profitable, and beat the S&P 500. Not necessarily “huge gains” but reliable steady gains over time, so you don’t have to be glued to news headlines. It continues to do that, and is leading the S&P 500 by roughly 5% at present. My expectations in the coming months is that it will diverge more, and pull away further. I am still incredibly bullish on regional banks…many of them being are best current positions.

No need to talk about our winning positions. Many of these winners we have compounded the wins by adding to them. Add to your winners, not your losers.

Average return is 5.92% with a net sum return of 52.2%.

I’m pleased with this, as I personally opted for a “lazy” portfolio this year due to the chaotic news.

Lets Instead Focus on the Losers…

The loser stocks are either small positions (CXDO) or I am just sitting on…like QS or the silver miner PAAS. Figured an update on those would calm some nerves…or help you decide if you want to cut it…which is totally ok! No one, including me, bats 100% accuracy!

First…remember I am looking at the weekly and monthly charts. Some of these stocks can swing +/- 20% or +/- 30%… or more… and still be in a bull trend. I am cognizant some of them locally, have sucked. Lets walk through those.

  • Cutting FedEx, FDX. This was a profitable position, but since the Amazon news about deliveries, it has just lost momentum. Taking a small loss, ~ -1.7%.

  • T1 Energy, TE: A lot of people doubted my “croissant” method with Xometry. I know its ridiculous. Xometry was painful for a period of time…it has become our 2nd most profitable trade of the year. The weekly trend remains up, higher lows continue to form, and price action remains well inside the “croissant.”

  • PAAS, Silver Miner (and Silver): We traded PAAS originally last year and made a healthy +30%. Then we avoided the silver flash crash of -41% and I sent out the “Selling Silver Miner Alert” on the 29th of January (a rare moment I feel like I timed a top perfectly.) Then we got back in late April. Has it sucked? Sure. Has anything changed? Not really. PAAS can draw down -70%… and still be in a bull trend.

When we zoom out even further, we see that the trend remains up, and still relatively early. We are likely retesting the 2008 high. This is the very first consolidation after a breakout. Can I guarantee that it will reverse back up? Never. But overall, there is nothing on these monthly charts that is scaring me off. Additionally…gold and silver love to go up when there is devastating news or chaos. If anything is guaranteed the next few years…its more chaos. I think by simply being patient, this will go back up, in time.

  • Crexendo, CXDO. This is a smaller position simply because it is my penny stock, moon shot bet of the year. I’m chasing more of a % win, for bragging, than $’s. The VCP remains intact, with more higher lows. Similar to silver, it appears to be retesting the highs. Company fundamentals are still solid, with rapidly increasing cash flow and EPS. Just simply a volatile stock. If this stock moves back upwards, then I will add. If it breaks below $5.40, I will cut. Will be a big % loss, but a small $ loss. Gotta risk it for the biscuit!

  • Quantum Scape: I’ve already beat this dead horse. I’m not selling. Betting on solid state batteries long term. The news about Honda and Quantumscape was a huge fundamental development. The worst position in the portfolio right now. I remember assets like Ethereum and HBAR back in 2019, being down -40% and -50%. Just sat on them. Then made a fortune in 2021. Of course I could be wrong about QS….but I think some patience will pay off. Preferably sooner than later though!

Overall, I’ve been pretty pleased with portfolio performance this year. Naturally everyone wants everything to go up, instantly and rapidly. Me to! But that is simply not how the market works. Especially when we are doing “lazy portfolio” to be able to ignore headlines.

At the end of the day, you have to sleep with your portfolio. If you want to cut or trim a position, do it! If you want to make fun of me about a losing stock, I’ll include the “leave a comment” button down below to help you out! This is as transparent and as open as I can get… you do what is best for you.

Leave a comment

Again, I will swing in when I can while I am out. Thanks for stopping by!
